verdict.rationale: Mangopay is marketplace payments infrastructure, so seller-facing statements and reconciliation exports are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, documents no per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper exports. The embedded UI evidence covers only checkout, bank-account registration, and card vaulting. The 'bank statement' item refers to custom text on a payer's bank statement, not seller statements.
